name: gvsig-online
description: Web platform for simplified creation and management of geoportals and Spatial Data Infrastructures (mirror from official SVN)

paragraphs: gvSIG Online is a platform for the publication and management of geographic information, by providing an integrated interface for publishing new layers, defining symbology, creating new mapviewers and defining permissions for each published resource. gvSIG Online is a web application written in Python using the Django framework. It integrates with Geoserver and optionally also with Geonetwork.
gvSIG Online has been developed by Scolab and the gvSIG Association and it is available under the Affero GPL license.
